what: The angle matrix speaks FUNCTIONAL names (caption-pipeline, youtube-caption...); features/features.json speaks DIRECTORY names (_main, app/webview...). This file is the declared translation between the two, so an angle row is auditable against the tracked tree instead of living in a parallel world. A macro feature with no functional owner is listed under `uncovered_macro` WITH its reason -- coverage is declared, never implied.

features.what: worker JSONL -> shell routing -> overlay paint + history store
CDP snapshot -> clock/seek/pause witness -> served cue
final lines -> history/<date>/<hour>.md, idempotent on start=
whole-tree steady-state: the product soak over the product's own artifacts

uncovered_macro._recovered: frozen pre-loss snapshots; no runtime surface to falsify
uncovered_macro.app/_legacy-electron: dead tree -- the Electron app is morto (AGENTS.md)
uncovered_macro.app/verify: Rust stubs with their own receipt, app/verify/verify-run.log
uncovered_macro.bend_core: needs WSL ubuntu-bend; BEND2/WSL retired by owner order 2026-11-25
uncovered_macro.discord: needs DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN; the alternative route only when the owner asks
uncovered_macro.probe: diagnostic taps; their proof is their own probe/*.log
uncovered_macro.root-entrypoints: thin entrypoints; covered by the battery, not by an angle
uncovered_macro._tools: read-only SQLite censuses over the miniMax runtime store; no product surface they can break
uncovered_macro.app/shadowplay: covered by scripts/gate.py stage `tests` (app/shadowplay/run-all.mjs suites), which is a driver stage, not an angle row
uncovered_macro.scripts: covered by scripts/gate.py stages `pytest` and `task-resolver` -- the rails those scripts guard are their own gate
